text:
jake_support: @maria_cs heads up — Aurora Health trial hit a blocker during final SSO provisioning. Customer on 14-day trial, renewal signal in ~48h if activation doesn't complete. Escalating to CS for priority takeover.

jake_support: Symptoms: provisioning job returns 502 for tenant=aurora-287, SSO assertion intermittently failing. Repro attempted in staging and prod. Error snippet below.
```
ERROR 2026-02-18T10:12:34Z tenant=aurora-287 provisioning: 502 upstream: identity-service token exchange failed: invalid_grant
```

maria_cs: thanks for flagging. Can you drop the last_request_id and region? I'll schedule a customer-facing bridge for today EOD. :eyes:  

jake_support: last_request_id=req_9f3a12, region=us-west-2. Quick manual workaround: token rotation in the admin UI lets provisioning proceed for ~10 minutes.

oliver_csm: Proposed ops rally / comms plan — 1) immediate tech triage with eng (sam_eng) to confirm root cause + ETA; 2) 30m bridge with Aurora PM at 16:30 PT to acknowledge and share temporary workaround; 3) enablement session after stabilization to walk through auth retry behavior; 4) follow-up email + renewal note to account team. Roles: maria -> customer comms & bridge, sam -> technical lead, jake -> support owner.

sam_eng: I can join now. My hunch: intermittent refresh_token expiry / clock skew + a recent token-cache TTL tweak. Short-term mitigation: server-side retry w/ small backoff and force token refresh. If keys are available, I can push a canary fix within ~3h. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: booking 16:30 PT bridge and drafting comms now. Draft outline: apology, what we saw, immediate workaround, ETA for fix, next steps. Tagging @deploy-bot for recent deploys to auth.

deploy-bot: Recent deploys affecting auth-service: 2026-02-18T09:45Z auth-service v2.3.7 -> v2.3.8 (config: token-cache TTL changed from 300s -> 120s).

jake_support: that aligns with the timeline customers reported. I'll keep monitoring provisioning retry logs and send periodic updates here. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: sending calendar invite + bridge link to Aurora (PM + SE). After the bridge we'll capture feedback and open a follow-up ticket for the renewal team to flag potential churn risk. Meeting owner: maria_cs; tech owner: sam_eng; support owner: jake_support.

oliver_csm: Post-bridge playbook: timeline of events, root cause, mitigation, customer impact window, explicit ask for renewal team if needed, and any promissory commitments. I'll draft the postmortem template and assign owners.

jake_support: update 17:05 PT — sam deployed hotfix to canary. Ran 3 provisioning tests against aurora-287: all succeeded. Monitoring for 30m.

maria_cs: great news — I'll relay to Aurora and close the immediate comms loop. If anyone sees a relapse, ping this thread immediately and we'll escalate back into the bridge.
